core.nameFullTitle: The Rt Rev. the Lord Bishop of Gloucester

focus: Crime, civil law, justice and rights

synopsis: The Lord Bishop of Gloucester's full title is The Rt Rev. the Lord Bishop of Gloucester. Her name is Rachel Treweek, and she is a current member of the House of Lords.

history.heading: Sports: Further Education
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what consideration they have given to protecting nationally significant dual-career education pathways that combine further education with elite athlete development as part of reforms to 16-to-19 skills funding.
